title: Developing Custom Chinese Hamster Ovary-host Cell Protein Assays using Acoustic Membrane Microparticle Technology
protocol: Label antibodies using Biotin NHS Chemistry.
Determine the degree of biotinylation.
Conjugate Streptavidin Beads with biotinylated antibody.
Resuspend beads in the original vial by vortexing for 1-2 minutes.
Aliquot desired volume of beads into a microcentrifuge tube.
Wash beads 3 times with PBST.
Place the tube containing the beads on the magnet for 2 minutes.
Remove supernatant by aspiration while maintaining the tube on the magnet.
Remove tube from the magnet and add 1 mL PBST.
Vortex for 20 seconds to resuspend beads.
Centrifuge for 5 seconds to remove beads from cap.
Repeat washing steps twice more after initial wash.
Add biotinylated antibody to washed beads and resuspend.
Incubate bead/antibody suspension for 30 minutes at RT on vortex shaker or tube rotator.
Wash beads 3 times with PBST as in step 3.
Block beads with biotinylated BSA after third wash.
Add 10 μg/mg biotinylated BSA, adjust volume to 300 μL with PBS if necessary.
Incubate mixture with agitation for 30 minutes.
Wash beads 3 times with PBST as in step 3 again.
Resuspend the beads in 100 μL of PBS/0.05% BSA.
Add sodium azide for long-term storage if desired.
Dilute Fl-Ab stock with BioScale Bead/FlAb Diluent to achieve a working concentration of 1.6 μg/mL for CHO-HCP assays.
Vortex bead stock well before removing an aliquot.
Dilute bead stock with BioScale Bead/FlAb Diluent to prepare a solution at a concentration of 8x10^5 beads/mL.
Mix calibrators and samples with BioScale Sample Diluent.
Turn the ViBE Workstation on.
Connect the system supply and waste.
Prime the system.
Insert a ViBE Cartridge.
Route the tubes.
Prepare assay template by filling out the sheet labeled "Sample Setup".
Fill out the table in the top left corner with the concentration range of the standards.
Enter additional information in the adjacent tables to instruct the ViBE Workstation on incubation times, reagent volumes, and other necessary steps.
Fill out the plate layout as specified.
Load sample/reagents into plates using the required volumes provided by the ViBE.
Apply plate covers securely.
Load plates onto workstation deck.
Run the assay start up wizard and follow instructions to begin the assay.
On a ViBE Workstation, perform an AMMP assay to measure antigen concentration.
Signal is measured when the bead-antigen-hapten antibody binds to the sensor through the hapten/anti-hapten interaction.
Regenerate the sensor by removing immune complexes to return it to the beginning state.
